name: Sqwakie
description: Split one open-weight model across opted-in team machines with llama.cpp RPC and serve an OpenAI-compatible API on localhost; also links Claude Code and Codex agents.
compatibility: Pooled runs use llama.cpp RPC over Sqwakie between the team's machines; the OpenAI-compatible API is served on 127.0.0.1.
Pre-release binaries cover macOS on Apple Silicon and Linux x64/arm64; Windows only through WSL2 as Linux.
limitations: v0.2 pre-release. Sharing is off by default; a person on each machine must turn pooled model runs on.
The README does not document hardware requirements or which llama.cpp backends pooled runs use.
Needs a Sqwakie team: the Free plan covers up to 2 people and 4 machines; larger teams need a paid per-person plan.
Licensing calls home for one-time activation and, on paid plans, a daily renewal check. When no direct path exists, an encrypted relay sees connection metadata such as IP addresses.
Source-available license (FSL-1.1-ALv2), not OSI open source; each version becomes Apache-2.0 two years after release.

sources.note: Pooled local models (walkie pool, walkie pool run, llama.cpp RPC, OpenAI-compatible API on 127.0.0.1, sharing off by default), install and platforms, Free plan and pricing, licensing calls, relay behavior, and license summary.
